items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: the first writing I did was with Mercer Ellington. Mercer had the band... I wrote some, Billy Strayhorn wrote some, Mercer wrote some.

ctx.x: And it started that way, in that direction. For instance, oh, the first writing I did was with Mercer Ellington. Mercer had the band, recorded on Decca Records. I wrote some, Billy Strayhorn wrote some, Mercer wrote some.
Was that the one, 'Stepping In Swing Society,' I think they called the album? It was recorded --
